IEA PASSENGER INFORMATION
CHECK IN TIMES: Passengers are requested to check in at the
airport counter 30 minutes before scheduled departure time.
Reservations not claimed 15 minutes before scheduled depar-
ture time are subject to cancellation.
BAGGAGE: Each passenger is allowed one average size bag,
limited to 40 pounds, and one "carry-on" piece such as a brief.
case or cosmetic case. Baggage liability is $750.00 per
passenger.
RESERVATIONS: IEA flights may be overbooked to compen-
sate for persons holding and NOT utilizing reservations. To in-
sure passage, passengers are requested to check in early.
CREDIT CARDS: IEA accepts VISA, Bankamericard, and
Master Charge cards.
CHILDREN: Children under two years of age, accompanied by
an adult, will be carried free. Children between two and eleven,
when accompanied by an adult, will be charged 50% of the full
fare.
INTERLINE CONNECTIONS: IEA connects to all major airlines
at Los Angeles, San Francisco, and Fresno.
EQUIPMENT: Swearingen Metro I Jet Prop or Piper Chieftain
Commuter Aircraft.
RESPONSIBILITY: IEA reserves the right to cancel or change
schedules or fares without notice. Schedules shown are based
on expected flying times and departure and arrival times are
not guaranteed.
COUNTER LOCATIONS: Los Angeles, American Airlines Ter-
minal No. 4, San Francisco, Central Terminal, Visalia Airport,
Terminal Building, Fresno, Main Terminal Building. For addi-
tional information, see maps.
/EAT
WE WANT TO BE YOUR AIRLINE /EA
